items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer mentions Monk crashing at Sheila's place; Interviewee responds about Sheila being a good host to musicians, but does not mention a personal interaction with Monk.

ctx.x: Cause I know Monk ended up crashing there at Sheila’s place at times.

Oh yeah, and Sheila was such a good host to any musician that needed a place to stay, or a meal or anything. She was mom to a lot of people. Which was weird because she couldn’t take care of herself very well.
